verdict.rationale: PayPal hosts the Agent Toolkit source in a public first-party GitHub repo (paypal/agent-toolkit), also published on npm, so part of the product's source is readable. The core agentic commerce services (Agent Ready, Store Sync, the cart API, and the hosted MCP server) appear to be closed, and no license is named anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: any evidence of an OSI/open license on the toolkit repo, published source for the core agentic commerce services and hosted MCP server, and independent confirmation of openness.
